patient_split: sorted cyclic: test=i, development=(i+1)%N, all others train
quality_policy: exclude unsupported or unpaired closure rows from label use for all methods
hyperparameter_selection: development patient AUPRC; ties prefer larger alpha then smaller edit_scale
calibration: speaker-equal Platt C=1 on development patient plus MC03; no class weighting
decision_threshold_selection: development macro-speaker F1; ties prefer threshold nearest 0.5 then higher
old_results_policy: historical published numbers are not compared to changed labels
